description: This file contains utility functions for handling MAC addresses and media type groups within the tlvf namespace, including conversions between string and binary formats, and printing media type group names.

methods.name: int_to_hex_string
methods.description: Converts an unsigned integer to a zero-padded hexadecimal string with specified digit length.

methods.name: mac_to_string
methods.description: Converts a MAC address in uint8_t array or sMacAddr struct to a string representation.

methods.name: mac_from_string
methods.description: Parses a MAC address string into a uint8_t array buffer.

methods.name: mac_from_string (overload)
methods.description: Creates an sMacAddr struct from a MAC address string.

methods.name: mac_to_array
methods.description: Copies MAC address bytes from sMacAddr to a uint8_t array.

methods.name: mac_from_array
methods.description: Copies bytes from a uint8_t array into an sMacAddr struct.

methods.name: mac_from_array (returning sMacAddr)
methods.description: Creates an sMacAddr struct from a uint8_t array.

methods.name: print_media_type_group
methods.description: Returns a string name for a media type group integer.
